sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; top two choices were duplicates, so the run pivoted within the same table to arXiv:2607.04728.
Main agent read arXiv abstract, HTML, PDF metadata, and TeX source, then wrote a 5000+ Chinese-character Markdown analysis.
The article reconstructs SIS formulas, top-K approximation, pseudocode, main tables, staleness/MoE/no-clipping ablations, and failure boundaries.
External reference search found arXiv/HTML/source/PDF as primary evidence; no stronger independent technical review was used for claims beyond the paper.
Markdown uses TL;DR, tables, formulas, pseudocode, and Mermaid-free structured sections; no external images are embedded.
